messages:
emma: FYI onboarding smoke for aurora-30b-int4 showed a RoPE cycle + kvcache remap after very long prefill. outputs collapse to short repeats. repro attached.

emma: repro cmd: `./serve_test.sh --model aurora-30b --quant int4 --prefill-file huge_prompt.txt --max-tokens 110000 --seed 7`

raju: can you drop the smallest log slice when the collapse starts? kernel + runtime commit?

emma: snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T01:12:03Z] ROPE: pos=65536 -> wrap_detected, phase_idx=0
[2026-03-21T01:12:03Z] KVCACHE: append global_idx=131072 mapped_to=0
[2026-03-21T01:12:04Z] TOKEN_GEN: repeated sequence detected, entropy low
```

emma: runtime `serving-runtime@c3d9f1b`, kernels `fused-attn-int4-optim`

tessa: sounds like two things happening: rotary position counter overflow + kv index coalescing on quant path. Could be a 32-bit->16-bit trunc when computing mapped indices on int4 codepath.

raju: +1. Steps I propose: 1) run int4 with `ROTARY_SCALE=2.0` env (stretch positions), 2) run with `FORCE_KERNEL=int8` to see if quant kernels are culpable, 3) enable `KVCACHE_STRICT=1` to abort on any remap so we get full stacktrace.

emma: starting (1) and (2) now, will dump full debug log.

infra-bot: job aurora-30b-int4-1715002500 queued by emma on cluster-gpu-a

tessa: also try `ROTARY_LUT_ALIGN=128` — some int4 kernels pack lut tables differently and alignment bugs can flip sign bits when positions wrap.

ops-sre: tagging infra team for kernel history: @infra-sre any recent fcalls on fused-attn-int4-optim around pos math?

infra-bot: @infra-sre notified (pager duty).

raju: if int8 is stable and int4 fails, we need a guard in onboarding: prefills up to 120k tokens under quant path + kvcache_strict run. add as gating test.

emma: int8 run finished: no collapse through 110k tokens. int4 run still collapses reproducibly at ~98.7k tokens. dumping `KVCACHE_STRICT` output now.

emma: KVCACHE_STRICT log: `remap_abort: global_idx=131072 -> mapped 0 at shard 3 (calc overflow at idx_mod32=0xFFFF)`

tessa: that `idx_mod32=0xFFFF` smells like a signed/unsigned wrap earlier in remap arithmetic. I'll inspect kernel index math.

raju: next: bisect kernels between fused-attn-int4-optim@v2 and v3 (last changed pos_scaling and packing). emma can you attach the exact kernel artifact hashes to the ticket?

emma: attached in ticket #ML-8272 (artifact ids + prompt + seed). opening a short PR to add onboarding prefills and kvconsistency check.

ops-sre: thanks. we'll keep infra alert in case hotfix is needed for production Dedicated pools.

raju: TL;DR for handbook: quant-onboard must include (a) prefills sweep to 120k, (b) KVCACHE_STRICT run, (c) compare int4 vs int8 for longcontext. I'll draft the checklist once we confirm root cause.

emma: sounds good. Will follow up with results of kernel bisect and ROTARY_LUT_ALIGN trial. :thumbsup:
